description_en: Retrieves candidate media assets based on an input face image and returns the IDs of the candidate media assets. To obtain the video clips in which the person appears, call SearchMediaClipByFace
description_zh: 根据输入的人脸图片检索候选媒资，返回候选媒资 ID。需要获取人物在视频中的出现片段时，可继续调用 SearchMediaClipByFace
name: SearchMediaByFace

parameters.help_en: The current page number. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_no

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回的数据条数。默认值为10，最大值为50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The URL of the face image
parameters.name: person_image_url

parameters.help_en: This parameter is used to determine whether the paginated results are returned under the same search conditions. It is used in conjunction with the FaceSearchToken parameter in the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612891.html
parameters.help_zh: 通过该参数判断是同一个搜索条件下的分页返回，与https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612891.html里的FaceSearchToken配合使用
parameters.name: face_search_token

parameters.help_en: The name of the search library
parameters.name: search_lib_name

parameters.help_en:
The media asset type. Valid values:
image: Image.
video: Video
parameters.help_zh:
媒资类型。取值：
image：图片
video：视频
parameters.name: media_type

parameters.help_en:
The custom filters. The value is a JSON string. Supported fields include the integer field intField1 and the string fields strField1 and strField2. You can select at most one match type for the same field. Filters for different fields are combined by using the AND operator.
Exact match, such as {"intField1":12,"strField1":"abc"}.
Multi-value match, such as {"intField1":[12,13],"strField1":["abc","cd"]}.
Range match, such as {"intField1":{"gte":12,"lte":13}}
parameters.name: custom_filters

parameters.help_en:
The creation time. The value is a timestamp in milliseconds. gte indicates greater than or equal to, and lte indicates less than or equal to.
Range match, such as {"gte":1761205662998,"lte":1771205662998}
parameters.help_zh:
创建时间，毫秒时间戳。gte大于等于，lte小于等于。
范围，如{"gte":1761205662998,"lte":1771205662998}
parameters.name: utc_create

MediaInfoList.description_en: The collection of media assets that meet the search conditions

items.description_en: The list of media asset information

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the operation is successful. Valid values: true: Successful. false: Failed
Success.description_zh: 操作是否成功。取值：true：成功。false：失败

Total.description_en: The total number of media assets that meet the search conditions
Total.description_zh: 满足搜索条件的媒资信息总条数
